name: labs/croningp__chemputersoftware
title: IKA RET Control Visc hotplate stirrer
intro: IKA RET Control Visc hotplate stirrer, adapted from croningp/chemputersoftware. It reads `medium_temperature`, `stir_rate` and `ph`; sets `temperature_setpoint` and `stir_rate_setpoint`; runs `set_temperature`, `start_heating`, `stop_heating`, `start_stirring` and 2 more. `set_temperature`: set the target temperature of a thermal zone and optionally wait for the zone to reach the setpoint within a declared tolerance. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
